themes.name: 晨曦蓝调
themes.description: 晨光微亮的蓝色基调，浅底配深蓝强调，标题轻底色块、引用为经典色条，适合技术文章与日常工作记录。
themes.descriptionEn: A bright morning-blue palette on white, with light-bg headings and a classic accent bar on quotes — calm enough for technical writing and daily notes.

themes.name: 青竹雅韵
themes.description: 竹青主色配叶片点缀，二级标题带对称叶形，引用为渐隐描边，整体清润雅致。
themes.descriptionEn: Bamboo green with paired leaf marks on H2 headings and a soft gradient quote edge — fresh and literary without being loud.

themes.name: 落日熔金
themes.description: 暖橙配衬线字与宽行距，标题为药丸三角、引用双层套框，晚霞般浓郁，适合散文与长文。
themes.descriptionEn: Warm orange, serif type and generous spacing; pill-triangle headings and double-framed quotes give long essays a sunset warmth.

themes.name: 星河夜航
themes.description: 暗色底加细点网格，蓝色星辉贯穿标题、引用与提示块，配深色代码窗，适合夜间阅读的长文。
themes.descriptionEn: A dark dot-grid page with blue starlight running through headings, quotes and callouts, plus a dark code window — built for night reading.

themes.name: 雨过天青
themes.description: 雨后天青的冷调蓝，衬线正文，一级标题下划块、二级标题浅底，引用为玻璃卡片，清透克制。
themes.descriptionEn: Rain-washed cool blue with serif text: an underlined H1, light-bg H2 and glass-card quotes — clear and restrained.

themes.name: 素笺工笔
themes.description: 近乎无色的素笺，灰墨衬线字与宽字距，标题四角钉、引用双边线，留白充裕，最接近纸面工笔。
themes.descriptionEn: Almost colourless paper: grey ink, wide letter-spacing, corner-nailed headings and double-edged quotes — the closest to fine-line print.

themes.name: 鎏金古典
themes.description: 纸纹暖底配鎏金衬线，标题为匾额、引用为古典色条、图片加墨框，端庄复古。
themes.descriptionEn: Gold on textured warm paper: plaque headings, classic accent-bar quotes and ink-framed images — formal and old-fashioned in the best way.

themes.name: 樱粉温柔
themes.description: 樱粉主色配暖色点格底，圆润药丸标题与四角钉引用，暗色代码窗，柔和而不腻。
themes.descriptionEn: Cherry pink on a warm dot-grid page, with rounded pill headings, corner-nailed quotes and a dark code window.

themes.name: 深海静谧
themes.description: 深海青蓝的冷调，渐变圆角标题与玻璃质感引用，蓝色带分隔线，安静沉稳。
themes.descriptionEn: Deep-sea teal with rounded gradient headings, glass-card quotes and a sky-band divider — quiet and steady.

themes.name: 麦浪秋色
themes.description: 麦黄与琥珀的秋色，纸纹底配衬线字，标题为垂帘、引用特大引号、图片配纸质说明，丰收气息。
themes.descriptionEn: Harvest gold and amber on paper texture: curtain headings, oversized quote marks and paper-captioned images.
